verdict.rationale: USCIS runs a first-party Torch developer platform that documents a Case Status API and a FOIA Request and Status API. It also lays out a key-issuance path: register a developer account, join or create a team, build in the sandbox, then pass a demo to receive production keys. The evidence shows no stated rate limits and no published endpoint paths or specs, and production access is gated behind a demo review. missing for 10: stated rate limits, published endpoint paths/reference specs, independent or hands-on corroboration of key issuance.
